content: प्रवर्तनम् .²1 Going on, moving forward. .²2 Beginning, commencement. .²3 Setting on foot, founding, establishing, instituting. .²4 Prompting, urging, simulating, inciting. .²5 Engaging in, applying oneself to. .²6 Happening, coming to pass. .²7 Activity, action. .²8 Behaviour, conduct, procedure. .²9 Directing, superintending. .²10 Employment. .²11 Exhortation. .{@-ना@} Inciting or prompting to action; अस्ति प्रवर्तनारूपमनुरूपं चतुर्ष्वपि <ls>Bh.</ls>
